name: r019.keep_watch_meaningful_event_validation_mcw
description: Fresh, separately authorized R-019 guarded-stop validation. It consumes the already-proved staged hostile-sighting fixture but has its own registry authority and immutable report. The first hostile-sighting classification must stop Keep watch before any unsafe continuation.

input: fresh-frame cockpit Keep watch dispatch only

proof_gates.label: R-019 guarded Keep watch stops at the declared hostile sighting before unsafe continuation

steps.label: dismiss_declared_in_game_main_menu
steps.expected_visible_fact: the declared native in-game main menu is dismissed before the guarded safety frame is observed

steps.label: post_load_r019_meaningful_event_hud
steps.abort_reason: the staged source-bound fixture did not reach ordinary gameplay

steps.label: emit_r019_meaningful_event_native_frame
steps.expected_visible_fact: the canonical launcher verifies a current run-bound native world frame before it admits the guarded dispatch

steps.label: r019_meaningful_event_guarded_live_session
steps.objective: From the staged hostile-sighting fixture, issue game.keep_watch only from its fresh native safety frame. Stop at the first hostile-sighting classification, preserve partial progress, native receipts, and a post-stop observation, then finish and ingest the immutable report.
proof_targets: a current native safety frame authorizes the guarded dispatch
the staged hostile sighting is classified explicitly and stops guarded waiting before unsafe continuation
the final record retains the exact stop reason, partial progress, native receipts, and post-stop observation
run.finish ingests only this fresh separate authority after accepted cleanup
authority: game.keep_watch with enabled recipe and evidence-derived target
invariants: the zero-credit bootstrap report is a source fact, never this run's authority
dispatch game.keep_watch only from a fresh safety frame
the declared hostile-sighting classification must stop without a further native dispatch
finish on the first meaningful, unsafe, unknown, stale, binding-drift, no-progress, or bound-exhaustion condition

evidence_contract.claim: a fresh separately authorized guarded Keep watch transaction consumes the declared staged hostile-sighting source, records its native frame and receipts, and stops fail-closed at the classified meaningful event before unsafe continuation
evidence_contract.failure_rule: bootstrap-authority reuse, changed source or binding, a non-fresh frame, missing native receipt, absent declared classification, any dispatch after stop, missing post-stop observation, failed ingestion, or failed cleanup leaves R-019 red
